book.name: Maluko
book.title: Mbuli Inogile ya Yesu Kilisito yandikigwe na Maluko

content: Munhu yeli na mkono uholole
Abaho Yesu kachola kabili mng'anda ya kumpula Imulungu. Ako kukala na munhu yakalile na mkono uholole.
Wanhu wayagwe wakalile aho walonda kilamuso cha kumtagusila Yesu, avo wamulola bunhuu kamba komuhonya munhu ayo mna isiku ya Kubwihila.
Yesu kamulongela munhu ayo yaholole mkono, “Ima hano kuulongozi.”

Abaho Yesu kawauza wanhu awo, “Vino Malagizo getu gotulonda tutende choni mna isiku ya Kubwihila? Kutenda ganogile hebu kutenda gehile? Kuuhonya ugima wa munhu hebu kuukoma?” Lakini wao wanyamala tuulu.
Yesu kawalola wanhu awo kwa kugevuzika, kawonela bazi mbuli ya udala wa mizoyo yao. Abaho kamulongela munhu ayo, “Golosa mkono wako.” Nayo kaugolosa mkono wake, na mkono wake uhona.
Abaho Mafalisayo walawa kunze mna ing'anda ya kumpula Imulungu, waiting'hana na wanhu wa Helode, wakala kiseto wamkome Yesu.
Lunhu lomkweleleza Yesu
Yesu na wanahina zake wachola kudilamba da Galilaya, lunhu mkulu lwa wanhu lumkweleleza. Walawa kuziisi za Galilaya na Yudea,

na buga da Yelusalemu, na isi ya Idumeya, na umwambu wa Yolidani, na kulawa mzimbaka zili mmabehi na mabuga ga Tilo na Sidoni. Wanhu wose awo wamcholela Yesu kwavija wahulika mbuli zake ziyakalile kotenda.
Kwavija lunhu lukala lukulu, Yesu kawalongela wanahina zake wamtandile ngalawa ili wanhu sikuwamsung'he sung'he.
Kwavija Yesu kawahonya wanhu wengi, avo wanhu wose wakalile watamu wakala oisung'ha sung'ha wadahe kumkwasa.
Wanhu wakalile na vinyamkela viwamonile Yesu, wamgwila kuulongozi waguta mizangi olonga, “Gweye kwa Mwana wa Imulungu!”
Lakini Yesu kawagomesa vinyamkela sikuwamulongele munhu yoyose kamba heyo kakala nani.
Yesu kosagula watumigwa longo na wabili
Abaho Yesu kakwela kukigongo, kawakema wanhu yawalondile mwenyego, nao wamgendela.
Kawasagula wanhu longo na wabili, kawakema watumigwa. Kawalongela, “Niwasagula mweye mukale na niye. Vivija nowagala mkawapetele wanhu Mbuli Inogile,
na mweye mokuwa na udahi wa kulava vinyamkela.”
Wano awo longo na wabili iyawasagule, wakala Simoni, Yesu kamgwaa twaga da Petulo
na Yakobo na ndugu yake Yohana, wanage Zebedayo kawagwaa twaga da Boanilige, fambulo jake, “Wana wa Ng'huwa”
na Andeleya na Filipo na Batulumayo na Matayo na Tomaso na Yakobo mwana wa Alufayo na Tadayo na Simoni Mkananayo,
na Yuda Isikaliote, yamuhinduke Yesu.
Yesu na Belizebuli
Abaho Yesu kachola ukae. Lunhu lwa wanhu luiting'hana kabili mbaka Yesu na wanahina zake walemelwa kuja.
Ndugu zake viwahulike avo, wagenda kumsola kwavija wanhu wakala olonga, “Kana kibozi mbwelela!”
Wafundiza Malagizo ga Musa wayagwe walawile Yelusalemu wakala olonga, “Kana Belizebuli! Ayo mkulu wa vinyamkela yomgwaa udahi wa kuwalava vinyamkela.”
Yesu kawakema na kawalongela kwa simo, “Vino Mwenembago kodahaze kumulava Mwenembago?
Kamba undewa wahaigola wenyego na kuitowa, undewa awo ogwa.
Wanhu wa lubuga lumoja wahaigola na kuitowa, lubuga lulo lofa.
Avo kamba undewa wa Mwenembago wahaigola wenyego, undewa awo ogwa na kuhelela baho.
“Kuduhu munhu yodaha kutula ng'anda ya munhu mwene nguvu na kusola vinhu vake, mbaka yasonge kumgodeka munhu ayo, baho kodaha kusola vinhu vake.
“Nowalongela ukweli, nzambi zose ziwatendile wanhu na maligo gao gose, Imulungu kodaha kugela kumgongo.
Lakini munhu yoyose yomuliga Loho Yang'alile, maligo gake hondagageligwe kumgongo bule, kwavija katenda nzambi ya milele.”
Yesu kalonga avo kwavija wanhu wakala olonga, “Kana kinyamkela.”
Mamake na ndugu zake Yesu
Abaho mamake na ndugu zake Yesu weza, wema kunze wamtuma munhu yamkeme Yesu.
Lunhu lwa wanhu lukala lumzunguluke Yesu. Nao wamulongela, “Go mkulu, mamako na ndugu zako wa kunze, okulonda gweye.”
Yesu kawedika, “Mamangu ayo nani? Na ndugu zangu wao nani?”
Baho kawalola wanhu awo wamzunguluke, kawalongela, “Loleni! Wano awo mamangu na ndugu zangu!
Munhu yoyose yotenda gaja golondigwa na Imulungu, ayo ndugu yangu na lumbu jangu na mamangu.”
